user.title: Connect to Forgejo
user.description: Enter the address of your Forgejo or Gitea instance and an API token. Create a token under Settings → Applications; read-only scopes are enough.

data_description.token: Needs read:repository, read:issue, read:notification and read:user
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn this off only for an instance using a self-signed certificate

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to Forgejo
reauth_confirm.description: The token for {url} is no longer accepted. Enter a new one.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the instance. Check the address, and whether Home Assistant can reach it.
error.invalid_auth: The token was rejected. Check that it is correct and has the required read scopes.
error.invalid_response: The address answered, but not like a Forgejo instance. If it sits behind a login proxy, that proxy has to allow /api/v1.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This account on this instance is already set up.

init.title: Repositories to track
init.description: Pick the repositories you want entities for. Each one is polled every five minutes, so tracking a large number makes for a lot of requests.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the instance to load the repository list.
